transcript.en: I've been meaning to ask you for some advice about restaurants－I need to book somewhere to celebrate my sister's 30th birthday and l liked the sound of that place you went for your mum's 50th.
transcript.zh: 我一直想问问你餐厅推荐的事——我需要订个地方给我姐姐庆祝30岁生日，听你说你去过的那家店（给你妈妈办50岁生日的地方）感觉挺不错的。

transcript.en: The Junction? Yeah, I'd definitely recommend that for a special occasion.
transcript.zh: The Junction吗？是的，如果是特殊场合，我肯定会推荐那里。

transcript.en: We had a great time there.  Everyone really enjoyed it.
transcript.zh: 我们在那里度过了一段美好的时光。每个人都真的很享受。

transcript.en: Where is it again? l can't remember!
transcript.zh: 在哪儿来着?我记不清了。

transcript.en: It's on Greyson Street, only about a two minute walk from the station.
transcript.zh: 在格雷森街，从车站走过去大约两分钟。

transcript.en: Oh, that's good.  I'd prefer not to have to drive anywhere.
transcript.zh: 哦，那太好了。我可不想开车去任何地方。

transcript.en: But l don't want to have to walk too far either.
transcript.zh: 但我也不想走太远。

transcript.en: Yes, the location's perfect but that's not necessarily why I'd recommend it.
transcript.zh: 是的，地理位置很完美，但这不一定是我推荐它的原因。

transcript.en: The food's amazing.  lf you like fish it's probably the best restaurant in town for that.
transcript.zh: 食物棒极了。如果你喜欢吃鱼，这里可能是城里最好的餐厅。

transcript.en: It's always really fresh and there are lots of interesting dishes to choose from.
transcript.zh: 它总是非常新鲜，而且有很多有趣的菜可以选择。

transcript.en: But all the food is good there.
transcript.zh: 但那里的食物都很好。

transcript.en: ls it really expensive?
transcript.zh: 真的很贵吗?

transcript.en: It's certainly not cheap but for a special occasion l think it's fine.
transcript.zh: 当然不便宜，但对于特殊场合来说，我觉得还不惜。

transcript.en: It's got a great atmosphere and before dinner you can go up on the roof and have a drink - it's really nice up there but you need to book.
transcript.zh: 那里气氛很棒，晚餐前你可以上楼顶喝一杯 -- 那里真的很棒，但你需要预订。

transcript.en: It's very popular as the views are spectacular.
transcript.zh: 它非常受欢迎，因为景色壮观。

transcript.en: Sounds good.  So that's definitely a possibility then.
transcript.zh: 听起来不错。那么，这确实是一种可能性。

transcript.en: ls there anywhere else you can think of?
transcript.zh: 你还能想到别的地方吗?

transcript.en: lf you want somewhere a bit less formal then you could try Paloma.
transcript.zh: 如果你想找个不那么正式的地方，可以试试帕洛玛，

transcript.en: Where's that? l haven't heard of it.
transcript.zh: 在哪儿?我没听说过。

transcript.en: No, it's quite new.  It's only been open a few months but it's got a great reputation already.
transcript.zh: 那家是新开的。虽然才开业几个月，但已经有不错的口碑了。

transcript.en: It's in a really beautiful old building on Bow Street.
transcript.zh: 它在波街上一栋非常漂亮的老建筑里。

transcript.en: Oh, I think l know where you mean - right beside the cinema?
transcript.zh: 哦，我想我知道你说的是哪里--就在电影院旁边吗?

transcript.en: Yes, that's it.  I've only been there a couple of times but l was really impressed.
transcript.zh: 是的，就是那里。我只去过那里几次，但真的印象深刻。

transcript.en: The chef used to work at Don Felipe's, apparently.
transcript.zh: 显然，那个厨师以前在费利佩先生那里工作过。

transcript.en: I was really sorry when that closed down.
transcript.zh: 那家店关门的时候我真的很难过。

transcript.en: So is all the food they serve Spanish, then?
transcript.zh: 那他们提供的所有食物都是西班牙风味的吗?

transcript.en: Yeah.  You can get lots of small dishes to share - which always works really well if you're in a group.
transcript.zh: 是啊。这里有很多小份的菜可以分享——如果是多人聚餐，这样安排特别合适。

transcript.en: Mmm.  Worth thinking about.
transcript.zh: 嗯，值得考虑。

transcript.en: Yeah.  There's a lively atmosphere and the waiters are really friendly.
transcript.zh: 是的，那里气氛很活跃，服务员也非常友好。

transcript.en: The only thing is that you need to pay a £50 deposit to book a table.
transcript.zh: 唯一的问题是，你需要支付 50 英镑的订金才能预订一张桌子。

transcript.en: A lot of restaurants are doing that these days.
transcript.zh: 现在很多餐厅都在这么做。

transcript.en: I should have a look at the menu to check there's a good choice of vegetarian dishes.
transcript.zh: 我应该看看菜单，看看有没有不错的素食菜单。

transcript.en: A couple of my friends have stopped eating meat.
transcript.zh: 我有几个朋友已经不吃肉了。

transcript.en: Not sure.  I'd say the selection of those would be quite limited.
transcript.zh: 不确定。我觉得那些菜的选择会相当有限。

transcript.en: I've just thought of another idea.
transcript.zh: 我刚刚想到了另一个主意。

transcript.en: Have you been to The Audley?
transcript.zh: 你去过奥德利吗?

transcript.en: No, don't think I've heard of it.  How's it spelt?
transcript.zh: 不，我想我没听说过。它是怎么拼写的?

transcript.en: A-U-D-L-E-Y.  You must have heard of it - there's been a lot about it in the press.
transcript.zh: A-U-D-L-E-Y。你一定听说过，报纸上有很多关于它的报道。

transcript.en: l don't tend to pay much attention to that kind of thing.  So where is it exactly?
transcript.zh: 我一般不太关注这种事，那么，它具体在哪里？

transcript.en: It's in that hotel near Baxter Bridge - on the top floor.
transcript.zh: 在巴克斯特桥附近的那间酒店 -- 顶层。

transcript.en: Oh, the views would be incredible from up there.
transcript.zh: 哦，从那里看到的景色一定很棒。

transcript.en: Yeah.  I'd love to go.
transcript.zh: 是的，我很想去。

transcript.en: I can't think of the chef's name but she was a judge on that TV cookery show recently.
transcript.zh: 我想不起那个厨师的名字了，不过她最近是那个电视烹饪节目的评委。

transcript.en: And she's written a couple of cookery books.
transcript.zh: 她还写了几本烹饪书。

transcript.en: Oh, Angela Frayn.
transcript.zh: 哦，安吉拉·弗雷思。

transcript.en: That's the one.  Anyway, it's had excellent reviews from all the newspapers.
transcript.zh: 就是那个，不管怎样，所有报纸都给了很好的评价。

transcript.en: That would be a memorable place for a celebration.
transcript.zh: 那将是一个值得纪念的庆祝场所。

transcript.en: Definitely.  Obviously it's worth going there just for the view but the food is supposed to be really special.
transcript.zh: 确实如此。单是为了欣赏风景也值得专程前往，不过那里的美食才堪称一绝。

transcript.en: She only likes cooking with local products, doesn't she?
transcript.zh: 她只喜欢用本地食材做饭，对吧?

transcript.en: Yes.  Everything at the restaurant has to be sourced within a short distance and absolutely nothing flown in from abroad.
transcript.zh: 是的。餐厅的所有食材都必须在短距离内采购，绝对不用国外空运进口的原料。

transcript.en: l imagine it's really expensive though.
transcript.zh: 不过我想那一定很贵吧。

transcript.en: Well, you could go for the set lunch.
transcript.zh: 好吧，你可以去吃午餐的套餐。

transcript.en: That's quite reasonable for a top class restaurant.  £30 a head.
transcript.zh: 对于一家顶级餐厅来说，这个价格相当合理: 每人 30英镑。

transcript.en: In the evening l think it'd be more like ￡50.
transcript.zh: 晚上的话，我觉得大概要 50 英镑。

transcript.en: At least that, l should think.  But I'm sure everyone would enjoy it.
transcript.zh: 至少我是这么认为的，但我相信每个人都会喜欢的。

transcript.en: It's not the kind of place you leave feeling hungry though, is it? With tiny portions?
transcript.zh: 不会吃不饱的，分量也不会太小，是吧？

transcript.en: No, the reviews I've read didn't mention that.  l imagine they'd be average.
transcript.zh: 不，我看过的评论都没提过这点。我想应该是中等分量吧。

transcript.en: Well, that's all great, thanks.
transcript.zh: 嗯，那太好了，谢谢。
